title: Senior Associate - Fund Admin
description:
**Company Description**
HC Global Fund Services, LLC is a specialized fund services firm founded in 2008 by six principals with extensive experience as Big 4 auditors, fund administrators, and buy-side finance and operations executives. The firm provides customized fund administration, tax, treasury, consulting, and related services to fund managers and investment advisors across a wide range of alternative investment structures. HC Global focuses on being a value-added partner, delivering responsive, client-specific solutions rather than a one-size-fits-all approach, regardless of client asset size. With approximately $55B in assets under administration, more than 1,400 funds, and 25,000+ investors serviced, the firm supports clients globally through 750+ team members across six countries and time zones. HC Global emphasizes institutional-quality standards, industry best practices, and strong client and investor relationships to support the growth of its clients.

**Client Service Functions**

• Prepares and performs first-level reviews of work completed by Associates to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Prepares Net Asset Value (NAV) reports and other client deliverables within agreed timelines.

• Communicates with clients via email and calls regarding routine operational matters and outstanding items.

• Assists Associates with technical queries and day-to-day deliverables.

• Prepares and reviews fund accounting workpapers, including:

o Position and cash reconciliations

o Accruals o Dividend and interest calculations

o Investment schedules

• Prepares investor statements, capital call and distribution notices, confirmation letters, and other investor communications, as applicable.

• Processes capital activities including subscriptions, withdrawals, contributions, distributions, and transfers. • Prepares allocation files, including management fees, administration fees, carried interest, waterfalls, performance fees, and clawback calculations, where applicable.

• Prepares treasury portal entries and supporting documentation.

• Assists in the preparation of financial statements and supporting schedules.  Escalates exceptions and critical issues to the Supervisor or Manager promptly.

• Ensures proper handover notes are provided for items requiring North America coverage.

• Demonstrates ownership of assigned funds and follows company best practices in servicing clients.

• Develops a thorough understanding of client operating agreements, private placement memorandums, engagement letters, and other governing documents.

• Adheres to company policies, procedures, and quality standards.

**Administrative Functions**

• Ensures timely submission of timesheets.

• Maintains knowledge of industry best practices and client-specific requirements.

• Supports Supervisors in ensuring timely completion of fund deliverables.

• Assists in onboarding new funds and transitioning client engagements.

• Provides guidance and on-the-job training to Associates.

• Participates in knowledge-sharing sessions and process improvement initiatives.

• Assists in documenting standard operating procedures and process updates.

• Participates in mandatory training programs and professional development initiatives.

• Supports management with ad hoc projects and operational requirements.

• Demonstrates flexibility and willingness to perform additional duties assigned by management.

In addition to the above, the Senior Associate may be required to assist with other operational or non-operational activities as determined by immediate supervisors, managers, or directors.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
CUBIC BUILDERS is a growing organization in the construction and infrastructure sector, focused on delivering high-quality projects with attention to detail and safety. The company values reliability, accurate project planning, and strong financial management to support sustainable growth. Team members collaborate closely across engineering, operations, and finance to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget. CUBIC BUILDERS encourages professional development and offers opportunities to contribute to meaningful projects in a dynamic work environment.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Accountant role based in Khandala. The Accountant will oversee day-to-day financial activities, including bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and maintenance of general ledgers. The role involves preparing and reviewing financial statements, monitoring project-related expenses, and assisting with budgeting and forecasting. The Accountant will ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal controls. Additional responsibilities include supporting audits, preparing management reports, and collaborating with project teams to provide accurate financial insights and cost tracking.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong accounting and bookkeeping skills, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable, and bank reconciliation.
* Proficiency in financial reporting and analysis, including preparation of balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow reports.
* Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and cost control, preferably in a construction or project-based environment.
* Familiarity with accounting software and ERP systems, along with solid Microsoft Excel skills.
* Understanding of tax laws, regulatory compliance, and audit processes relevant to business operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CPA, CA, or CMA) are an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and ability to maintain organized financial records.
* Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams on-site.
* Demonstrated integrity, accountability, and capacity to work independently while meeting deadlines.

title: Manager - Corporate Risk Management
description:
* Corporate Risk Management (L&T Group)

**Role Purpose**
Support the assessment, evaluation, and monitoring of project and enterprise risks across the L&T Group by facilitating pre-bid and execution risk reviews, reviewing contractual and commercial exposures, supporting bank guarantee recommendations, and ensuring adherence to Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender Risk Assessment & Risk Profiling
* Assess tender documents during the pre-bid stage and identify key project risks.
* Prepare comprehensive risk profiles covering:

+ Contractual Risks
+ Execution Risks
+ Commercial Risks
+ Counterparty Risks
+ Country Risks
+ Regulatory Risks (India and international markets)
+ Technology and Obsolescence Risks

* Provide risk-related inputs and recommendations to support informed bid decisions.

2
**. Pre-Bid & Execution Risk Reviews**

* Coordinate and facilitate Pre-Bid Risk Reviews and Execution Risk Reviews across L&T businesses.
* Organize and participate in project/site visits as required.
* Prepare project-specific risk assessments, risk profiles, portfolio analyses, and review reports.
* Support management in evaluating project risk exposure and mitigation strategies.
* Bank Guarantee Review & Recommendation Support
* Review requests for issuance and extension of bank guarantees for projects across the L&T Group.
* Evaluate proposals from contractual, commercial, and risk perspectives.
* Provide recommendations to support decision-making regarding bank guarantee approvals and extensions.
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Compliance
* Ensure adherence of Independent Companies (ICs) to the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework and related processes.
* Coordinate with IC Risk Teams to facilitate effective implementation of ERM requirements.
* Monitor compliance with risk management policies, procedures, and reporting requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to risk governance and risk management practices.

title: Associate Accountant (Fund Administration)
description:
**About Us**
HC Global Fund Services, LLC (“HC Global”) is a privately owned fund administrator serving fund managers and investment advisors in the alternative investments industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Duties and Responsibilities:**
*Middle and Back Office Functions*

* Gathers all information required (i.e. external statements, i.e., prime broker reports and custodian statements, supporting documents for recurring expenses including legal fees, audit fee, admin fees, tax fees, director’s fee, etc.).
* For Geneva clients, performs pricing of funds’ investments using prices from external sources.
* Uploads daily trade transactions from the prime broker’s FTP sites or trade blotter including the daily dividends, interest, corporate actions, and cash activities and record them in the HC Global’s portfolio accounting.
* Prepares daily equity reconciliation for each fund and if required by the engagement, also prepares position and cash reconciliation.
* Investigates any trade breaks and reconciling items on the reconciliation
* Based on downloaded reports and other calculations, prepares and/or updates the financial reports (trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, statement of changes in capital accounts, investors’ monthly and YTD allocations, capital letters, summary of expenses, schedule of management fees, etc.).
* Ensures that the monthly partners’ allocation is allocating the correct profit and loss based on the straight capital ratios or commitment ratios, whichever is the case maybe.
* Ensures that management fees and performance fees are allocating according to the limited partnership agreements.
* Ensures that all expenses are accrued, and all income and expense items are recognized in the appropriate tabs in the allocation file.
* Ensures that all income and expenses are classified in the right income and expense character for income tax purposes.
* Ensures the correctness of the monthly, quarterly and year to date gross and net returns for each limited partner.
* Ensures that all working papers are appropriately labeled and with proper notations and/or cell comments.
* Prepares the reporting package for next level review.
* Prepares all accounting related entries for Geneva clients, ensuring that all transactions have appropriate support.
* Monitors client mailboxes/distribution lists and saves all necessary emails and supports on a timely manner.
* Prepares ad hoc requests received from client, including but not limited to, distributions, drawdowns, etc.
* Prepares wire entries in the treasury portal for engagements with Cash Control services.
* Performs peer review of Investor statements, as needed.

*Assists in coordinating annual audits of clients’ financial statements.*

* Prepares working papers in a way that ensures that all audit requirements are handy for the auditors.
* Prepares year-end schedules for independent auditors including cost roll forward, cash reconciliation, statement of cash flows, and financial highlights and other working papers supporting the balances and disclosures in the financial statements.
* Prepares each fund’s financial statements and works closely with the respective fund’s auditors for note disclosures.
* Prepares and submits draft financial statements on a timely basis for next level review.
* Organizes own work, setting priorities and meeting critical deadlines.

**Requirements**
**Job Specifications:**

* Graduate of Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy
* Preferably a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Chartered Accountant (CA)
* Preferably with at least 1 year of experience in financial accounting or equivalent
* A team player; must be able to work individually and as part of a team
* Has a good business understanding of financial concepts and procedures
* Analytical and very detail-oriented
* Flexibility to expand work hours as necessary and support business needs
* Non-CPAs are welcome to apply

To be discussed during the application process.

title: Chartered Accountant
description:
Company Description CMRS & Associates LLP (formerly Chandrakant G. Doshi & Co.) is a Chartered Accountancy firm with over 50 years of experience in audit and assurance services. The firm provides a comprehensive range of professional services under one roof, including taxation, accounting, auditing, and consultation across Income Tax, GST, Sales Tax, and Service Tax. CMRS & Associates LLP also serves MSMEs, conducts internal audits, and undertakes specialized audits aligned with current regulatory and industry requirements. The firm has built a trusted client base across diverse industry sectors, offering long-term, relationship-driven professional support.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Chartered Accountant role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Chartered Accountant will manage statutory, tax, and internal audits, including planning, execution, documentation, and finalization of reports and financial statements. Responsibilities include preparing and reviewing financial statements, tax computations, and returns (Income Tax, GST, TDS), as well as supporting tax assessments and representations. The role involves performing analytical reviews, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax laws, and advising clients on financial, tax, and regulatory matters. The Chartered Accountant will coordinate with clients to gather information, resolve queries, maintain working papers, and contribute to process improvements within the firm.

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with valid membership in the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).

Strong knowledge of accounting standards, auditing standards, and financial reporting principles.

Hands-on experience in direct and indirect taxation, including Income Tax, GST, TDS, and related compliances.

Experience in statutory audit, internal audit, and tax audit for SMEs/MSMEs and/or larger enterprises.

Proficiency in accounting and audit tools (e.g., Tally, MS Excel, and other relevant audit software).

Ability to interpret and apply relevant tax laws, rules, and notifications to practical client situations.

Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

Effective written and verbal communication skills for client interaction, reporting, and documentation.

Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively within a team.

Prior experience in a CA firm or professional services environment is preferred.

title: Credit Management, Specialist
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Order Release Management:**

* Evaluate and process blocked orders based on customer credit status, outstanding balances, and payment history.
* Liaise with sales, customer service, and finance teams to ensure timely resolution of credit holds and maintain service levels.
* Escalate high-risk cases and recommend alternative solutions to facilitate order release without compromising risk exposure.

**Customer Credit Assessment:**

* Perform in-depth financial analysis and creditworthiness evaluations of new and existing customers.
* Review financial statements, conduct ratio analysis, and utilize external credit rating reports to determine credit limits.
* Continuously monitor customer portfolios and adjust credit lines as needed based on risk profile and market conditions.

**Credit Policy Compliance:**

* Ensure credit decisions comply with internal credit policy and risk tolerance guidelines.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of credit policies and procedures.
* Train and guide internal stakeholders on credit processes and risk awareness.

**Risk Mitigation and Management:**

* Identify customers with elevated risk levels and recommend appropriate risk mitigation tools such as: Credit insurance, Letters of credit, Bank guarantees, Advance payments
* Collaborate with legal and finance teams on drafting and implementing risk protection agreements.

**Reporting And Analysis/Collection Support**

* Generate regular credit risk reports and dashboards for senior management.
* Provide insights and analysis on customer payment behavior, credit utilization and risk trends.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date credit master data in the ERP system.
* Support the collections team by providing credit risk insights and prioritizing high-risk receivables.
* Participate in customer meetings or calls to resolve overdue issues when required.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify process gaps and propose improvements in credit evaluation, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
* Stay up to date on industry best practices, regulatory changes, and economic trends affecting credit risk.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor graduate and/or certificate of completion of job-related courses. Commerce/Finance preferred).
* 4+ of related experience, preferred in SSC/GBS/BPO environment.
* Experience with credit/debt instruments
* English written and verbal communication including ability to interact with all levels throughout the organization.
* SAP experience is mandatory.

title: F&B Controller
description:
**Job Description**
Job Summary:
  
  
The F&B Controller will be responsible for monitoring food and beverage costs, controlling inventory, analysing consumption, and ensuring efficient cost management across all restaurants, bars, kitchens, and other F&B operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor food and beverage costs, consumption, and operational expenses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly cost reports and MIS.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and physical stock audits.
* Analyse food costs, beverage costs, wastage, and variances.
* Monitor purchase prices, vendor rates, and adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef, F&B Operations, Stores, Purchase, and Finance teams.
* Ensure proper control over stock receipts, issues, transfers, and consumption.
* Verify recipe costing, portion control, and menu profitability.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and audit requirements.

**Job Expectations**
Strong knowledge of food and beverage costing, inventory management, and stock audits.
  
  
**Minimum Qualification**
Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  
  
**Minimum Job Experience**
5–8 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control
  
  
**Reporting To**
Finance Head
  
  
**Travel**
NA Apply Now
